1.web: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
1.asv: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.

2.web: The earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep and God’s Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.
2.asv: And the earth was waste and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep: and the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.

3.web: God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.
3.asv: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.

4.web: God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.
4.asv: And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness.

5.web: God called the light “day”, and the darkness he called “night”. There was evening and there was morning, the first day.
5.asv: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And there was evening and there was morning, one day.

6.web: God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”
6.asv: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.

7.web: God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so.
7.asv: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament: and it was so.

8.web: God called the expanse “sky”. There was evening and there was morning, a second day.
8.asv: And God called the firmament Heaven. And there was evening and there was morning, a second day.

9.web: God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear”; and it was so.
9.asv: And God said, Let the waters under the heavens be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.

10.web: God called the dry land “earth”, and the gathering together of the waters he called “seas”. God saw that it was good.
10.asv: And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that it was good.

11.web: God said, “Let the earth yield grass, herbs yielding seeds, and fruit trees bearing fruit after their kind, with their seeds in it, on the earth”; and it was so.
11.asv: And God said, Let the earth put forth grass, herbs yielding seed, and fruit-trees bearing fruit after their kind, wherein is the seed thereof, upon the earth: and it was so.

12.web: The earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, with their seeds in it, after their kind; and God saw that it was good.
12.asv: And the earth brought forth grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, wherein is the seed thereof, after their kind: and God saw that it was good.

13.web: There was evening and there was morning, a third day.
13.asv: And there was evening and there was morning, a third day.

14.web: God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of sky to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs to mark seasons, days, and years;
14.asv: And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days and years:

15.web: and let them be for lights in the expanse of sky to give light on the earth”; and it was so.
15.asv: and let them be for lights in the firmament of heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so.

16.web: God made the two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He also made the stars.
16.asv: And God made the two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he madethe stars also.

17.web: God set them in the expanse of sky to give light to the earth,
17.asv: And God set them in the firmament of heaven to give light upon the earth,

18.web: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. God saw that it was good.
18.asv: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that it was good.

19.web: There was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.
19.asv: And there was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.

20.web: God said, “Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of sky.”
20.asv: And God said, Let the waters swarm with swarms of living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.

21.web: God created the large sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind. God saw that it was good.
21.asv: And God created the great sea-monsters, and every living creature that moveth, wherewith the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind: and God saw that it was good.

22.web: God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”
22.asv: And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.

23.web: There was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.
23.asv: And there was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.

24.web: God said, “Let the earth produce living creatures after their kind, livestock, creeping things, and animals of the earth after their kind”; and it was so.
24.asv: And God said, Let the earth bring forth living creatures after their kind, cattle, and creeping things, and beasts of the earth after their kind: and it was so.

25.web: God made the animals of the earth after their kind, and the livestock after their kind, and everything that creeps on the ground after its kind. God saw that it was good.
25.asv: And God made the beasts of the earth after their kind, and the cattle after their kind, and everything that creepeth upon the ground after its kind: and God saw that it was good.

26.web: God said, “Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the sky, and over the livestock, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.”
26.asv: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the heavens, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.

27.web: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.
27.asv: And God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.

28.web: God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the sky, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.”
28.asv: And God blessed them: and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it; and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the heavens, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.

29.web: God said, “Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is on the surface of all the earth, and every tree, which bears fruit yielding seed. It will be your food.
29.asv: And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for food:

30.web: To every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the sky, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there is life, I have given every green herb for food;” and it was so.
30.asv: and to every beast of the earth, and to every bird of the heavens, and to everything that creepeth upon the earth, wherein there is life, I have given every green herb for food: and it was so.

31.web: God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. There was evening and there was morning, a sixth day.
31.asv: And God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And there was evening and there was morning, the sixth day.
